You can publish to the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/plugins#the-marketplace">Cursor Marketplace</a> or your <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/plugins#team-marketplaces">team&#x27;s private marketplace</a>.</p></div></div>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">MCP servers can be installed with Cursor deeplinks. <ol class="mb-4 prose-ol-markers" style="list-style-type:decimal;list-style-position:outside;padding-left:calc(4rem / 3);line-height:1.5">
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Get name and JSON configuration of server</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">JSON.stringify</code> the configuration then base64 encode it</li>
<li style="padding-inline-start:4px;margin:0 0 0.5rem 0;font-size:15px">Replace <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">$NAME</code> and <code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">$BASE64_ENCODED_CONFIG</code> with the name and encoded config</li>
</ol>

You can publish to the <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/plugins#the-marketplace">Cursor Marketplace</a> or your <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/plugins#team-marketplaces">team&#x27;s private marketplace</a>.</p></div></div>
<p class="text-base mb-4 leading-relaxed!">MCP servers can be installed with Cursor deeplinks. It uses the same format as <a class="text-foreground underline decoration-neutral-600 underline-offset-2 transition-colors hover:decoration-neutral-700" href="/docs/mcp"><code class="rounded-sm border border-border bg-card/80 p-1 font-mono text-xs">mcp.json</code></a> with a name and transport configuration.</p>
